tools.name: NetPanorama
tools.description: Declarative grammar/template toolkit for constructing, transforming, and visualising networks.
tools.notes: Vendored directly as public/bundle.js (starts with 'var NetPanoramaTemplateViewer') and loaded via a plain <script> tag in public/index.html in peacerep/actor-network — not an npm dependency, so missed by the package.json-only check. public/templates/ (jigsaw.json, list.json, network.json, timeline.json) confirms NetPanorama's own template format. Not present in implementation-narratives-tracker (checked, no bundle.js there).

tools.name: React
tools.description: JavaScript library/framework for building the app UI.
tools.notes: Confirmed via the react-dom bundle and webpackJsonp/Create React App build output on areav3.surge.sh (vis_tile_grid_map_peace_issues). No source_code link exists to check package.json directly; no separate charting/GIS library fingerprint found in the bundled JS, so the tile grid appears to be built with plain CSS/SVG in React components.

tools.name: Surge

tools.name: H5P
tools.description: Authoring tool for creating interactive HTML5 content, embedded here via iframe.
tools.notes: Confirmed via the h5p-resizer.js include and the iframe embed at html5.is.ed.ac.uk/psrp/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php?action=h5p_embed on peacerep.org/digital-resources/infographics/political-power-sharing/ (vis_pax_key_themes_infographics). H5P itself is open-source, unlike the other tools in this category, but functions the same way here: a hosted, low/no-code platform used to build and embed the content. Self-hosted by University of Edinburgh Information Services (html5.is.ed.ac.uk) rather than a third-party SaaS instance.

tools.name: Google Charts
tools.description: Google's charting library/API for rendering interactive charts.
tools.notes: Confirmed via gstatic.com/charts/loader.js and active google.visualization.BarChart/PieChart/DataView calls on peacerep.org/digital-resources/infographics/political-power-sharing/ (vis_pax_key_themes_infographics).

tools.name: University of Edinburgh Information Services
tools.description: Self-hosted University of Edinburgh infrastructure (as opposed to a third-party commercial host).
tools.notes: peaceagreements.org/tracker resolves to a University of Edinburgh IP block (129.215.x.x) and is served by gunicorn rather than a commercial PaaS (vis_pax_tracker, per direct user confirmation).
